question: Cracked Earth Technique earthbends 3 twice. Can I target the same land both times?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you can target the same land or two different lands.
expected.answer: You can target the same land or two different lands with the multiple instances of earthbend from Cracked Earth Technique.
